<h2 id="-about">🔍 About</h2>
<p><strong>DocuMind AI</strong> is an intelligent invoice processing and
document management web app for <strong>finance and procurement
teams</strong>. It automates the review, verification, and approval of
vendor invoices.</p>
<h3 id="the-problem">The problem</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Pain point</th>
<th>What happens today</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td>📄 <strong>Many formats</strong></td>
<td>Invoices arrive as PDF, scans, or XML and are keyed in by hand</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>🐢 <strong>Slow matching</strong></td>
<td>Three-way matching (invoice ↔︎ PO ↔︎ receipt) is done by eye and is
error-prone</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>⏰ <strong>Late exceptions</strong></td>
<td>Totals above a cap, unauthorized add-ons, and price drift surface
only at payment time</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>❓ <strong>No quick answers</strong></td>
<td>Reviewers can&#39;t ask a question and see <em>where</em> in the
document the answer comes from</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="the-solution">The solution</h3>
<p>DocuMind AI puts everything in one interface: a searchable invoice
queue, AI-extracted data beside the original document, automatic
PO-mismatch flags with reasons, a chat assistant that <strong>cites its
sources</strong>, and a KPI dashboard for managers.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>ℹ️ Release status — front-end prototype.</strong> The UI,
navigation, and state management are fully working. Invoice data, field
extraction, PO matching, analytics, and the assistant&#39;s replies are
<strong>simulated</strong> with sample data so the whole workflow can be
demoed without a back end. See <a href="#-what-is-real-vs-simulated">Real vs. Simulated</a>.</p>
</blockquote>

<h2 id="-how-it-works">🔁 How It Works</h2>
<pre class="mermaid"><code>flowchart LR
    A[⬆️ Upload invoice] --&gt; B[⚙️ 4-step AI pipeline]
    B --&gt; C[📋 Invoice queue&lt;br/&gt;status: Pending]
    C --&gt; D[🪟 Review in split-screen viewer]
    D --&gt; E{PO matches?}
    E -- Yes --&gt; F[✅ Approve]
    E -- No --&gt; G[🔴 Exception + reason]
    G --&gt; H[🤖 Ask AI assistant&lt;br/&gt;with citations]
    H --&gt; I[🚩 Flag / correct]
    F --&gt; J[📊 Dashboard KPIs]
    I --&gt; J</code></pre>
<p><strong>The four pipeline steps:</strong> validate the file → extract
tokens &amp; bounding boxes → classify fields → check the 3-way match
against open POs.</p>
<hr />
<h2 id="-architecture">🏗 Architecture</h2>
<p>A <strong>component-based single-page app with a single source of
truth.</strong> <code>App.tsx</code> owns the state and passes data and
handlers down to the views. Views never change each other directly —
they ask the root to update state, so badges, counts, and the header
exception badge always stay in sync.</p>
<p align="center"><img style="height:auto" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Architecture diagram" width="100%"></p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Layer</th>
<th>Responsibility</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td><strong>Presentation</strong></td>
<td>React 18 components styled with Tailwind CSS and Lucide icons</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><strong>State</strong></td>
<td><code>App.tsx</code> holds <code>invoices</code>,
<code>selectedInvoice</code>, <code>activeTab</code> and the
handlers</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><strong>Intelligence</strong></td>
<td>Thin Gemini SDK wrapper that builds invoice-aware prompts</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><strong>Tooling</strong></td>
<td>TypeScript for typed data; Vite for the dev server and production
bundle</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="data-flow">Data flow</h3>
<pre class="text"><code>App.tsx (state owner)
├── invoices[] ─────────────────► InvoiceTableView    (display, filter, search)
├── selectedInvoice ────────────► DocumentSplitViewer (view, edit, approve, flag)
│                               ► AiAssistantView     (chat about the invoice)
├── handleUpdateField()  ───────► edits an extracted field
├── handleApproveInvoice() ─────► status → &#39;Approved&#39;
├── handleFlagInvoice() ────────► status → &#39;Exception&#39; + reason
└── handleUploadDocument() ─────► adds an invoice and opens the viewer</code></pre>
<hr />

<p>In the prototype, vendor and PO are <strong>fields of the
invoice</strong>. The diagram shows how they would map to tables once a
back end exists.</p>
<p align="center"><img style="height:auto" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="ER diagram" width="100%"></p>

<span id="cb3-16"><a href="#cb3-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  extractedFields<span class="op">:</span> <span class="bu">Record</span><span class="op">&lt;</span><span class="dt">string</span><span class="op">,</span> ExtractedField<span class="op">&gt;;</span></span>
<span id="cb3-17"><a href="#cb3-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  lineItems<span class="op">:</span> LineItem[]<span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb3-18"><a href="#cb3-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span></code></pre></div>
</details>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb5-1"><a href="#cb5-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># 1. Get the code</span></span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a href="#cb5-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">git</span> clone <span class="op">&lt;</span>your-repository-url<span class="op">&gt;</span> documind-ai-pro</span>

<span id="cb5-6"><a href="#cb5-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">npm</span> install</span>

<span id="cb5-8"><a href="#cb5-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># 3. Add your API key</span></span>
<span id="cb5-9"><a href="#cb5-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">echo</span> <span class="st">&quot;GEMINI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key_here&quot;</span> <span class="op">&gt;</span> .env.local</span>

Studio</a></strong> and sign in with your Google account.</li>

project, and confirm.</li>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb6-1"><a href="#cb6-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">npm</span> install react@18 react-dom@18 lucide-react @google/genai</span>

<p><code>index.css</code></p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode css"><code class="sourceCode css"><span id="cb7-1"><a href="#cb7-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">@tailwind</span> base<span class="op">;</span></span>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb8"><pre class="sourceCode js"><code class="sourceCode javascript"><span id="cb8-1"><a href="#cb8-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">export</span> <span class="im">default</span> {</span>
<span id="cb8-2"><a href="#cb8-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">content</span><span class="op">:</span> [<span class="st">&#39;./index.html&#39;</span><span class="op">,</span> <span class="st">&#39;./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}&#39;</span>]<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb8-3"><a href="#cb8-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">theme</span><span class="op">:</span> { <span class="dt">extend</span><span class="op">:</span> {} }<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb8-4"><a href="#cb8-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="dt">plugins</span><span class="op">:</span> []<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb8-5"><a href="#cb8-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}<span class="op">;</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p><code>vite.config.ts</code></p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb9"><pre class="sourceCode ts"><code class="sourceCode typescript"><span id="cb9-1"><a href="#cb9-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> { defineConfig<span class="op">,</span> loadEnv } <span class="im">from</span> <span class="st">&#39;vite&#39;</span><span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb9-2"><a href="#cb9-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> react <span class="im">from</span> <span class="st">&#39;@vitejs/plugin-react&#39;</span><span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb9-3"><a href="#cb9-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb9-4"><a href="#cb9-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">export</span> <span class="im">default</span> <span class="fu">defineConfig</span>(({ mode }) <span class="kw">=&gt;</span> {</span>
<span id="cb9-5"><a href="#cb9-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="kw">const</span> env <span class="op">=</span> <span class="fu">loadEnv</span>(mode<span class="op">,</span> <span class="bu">process</span><span class="op">.</span><span class="fu">cwd</span>()<span class="op">,</span> <span class="st">&#39;&#39;</span>)<span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb9-6"><a href="#cb9-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">return</span> {</span>
<span id="cb9-7"><a href="#cb9-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    plugins<span class="op">:</span> [<span class="fu">react</span>()]<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb9-8"><a href="#cb9-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    server<span class="op">:</span> { port<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dv">3000</span><span class="op">,</span> host<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">&#39;0.0.0.0&#39;</span> }<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb9-9"><a href="#cb9-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    define<span class="op">:</span> { <span class="st">&#39;process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY&#39;</span><span class="op">:</span> <span class="bu">JSON</span><span class="op">.</span><span class="fu">stringify</span>(env<span class="op">.</span><span class="at">GEMINI_API_KEY</span>) }<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb9-10"><a href="#cb9-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  }<span class="op">;</span></span>

<h2 id="-usage-guide">🧭 Usage Guide</h2>
<details open>
<summary><b>Review an invoice</b></summary>

<ol type="1">
<li>Open <strong>Invoices</strong> and use the filter tabs or search to
find an invoice.</li>
<li>Click a row — <strong>Document Review</strong> opens.</li>
<li>Check the <strong>Extracted Fields</strong>; hover a field to see
its bounding box.</li>
<li>Fix any value with the ✏️ icon.</li>
<li>Check <strong>Line Items</strong> and <strong>PO
Matching</strong>.</li>
<li>Click <strong>Approve Invoice</strong>, or flag it with a
reason.</li>
</ol>
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Resolve an exception</b></summary>

<ol type="1">
<li>Select the <strong>Exceptions</strong> tab and open <strong>Redwood
Catering</strong> (total is $93.80 above the authorized cap).</li>
<li>Click <strong>Ask AI Assistant</strong> and try <em>&quot;Are there any
PO discrepancies?&quot;</em></li>
<li>Click a <strong>citation badge</strong> to jump to the supporting
region of the document.</li>
</ol>
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Add a new invoice</b></summary>

<ol type="1">
<li>Click <strong>Upload Invoice</strong>.</li>
<li>Drop a file (PDF, PNG, JPG, XML ≤ 20 MB) or click a sample such as
<strong>Summit Pkg</strong>.</li>
<li>Watch the four pipeline steps — the invoice opens in the viewer and
lands at the top of the queue.</li>
</ol>
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Check performance</b></summary>

<p>Open <strong>Dashboard Analytics</strong> for KPIs, weekly volume,
precision bars, and AI Insights.</p>
</details>

<hr />
<h2 id="-ai-integration-google-gemini">🤖 AI Integration (Google
Gemini)</h2>
<p>The assistant builds an <strong>invoice-aware prompt</strong>, asks
Gemini for <strong>structured JSON</strong>, and renders the answer with
citation badges.</p>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb11"><pre class="sourceCode ts"><code class="sourceCode typescript"><span id="cb11-1"><a href="#cb11-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> { GoogleGenAI } <span class="im">from</span> <span class="st">&#39;@google/genai&#39;</span><span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb11-2"><a href="#cb11-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb11-3"><a href="#cb11-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">const</span> ai <span class="op">=</span> <span class="kw">new</span> <span class="fu">GoogleGenAI</span>({ apiKey<span class="op">:</span> <span class="bu">process</span><span class="op">.</span><span class="at">env</span><span class="op">.</span><span class="at">GEMINI_API_KEY</span> })<span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb11-4"><a href="#cb11-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb11-5"><a href="#cb11-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">function</span> <span class="fu">buildInvoicePrompt</span>(question<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dt">string</span><span class="op">,</span> inv<span class="op">:</span> DocumentItem) {</span>
<span id="cb11-6"><a href="#cb11-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">return</span> [</span>
<span id="cb11-7"><a href="#cb11-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">&#39;You are an accounts-payable assistant.&#39;</span><span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb11-8"><a href="#cb11-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">&#39;Answer ONLY from the invoice data below.&#39;</span><span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb11-9"><a href="#cb11-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">&#39;Return JSON: {&quot;answer&quot;: string, &quot;citations&quot;: string[]}&#39;</span><span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb11-10"><a href="#cb11-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">&#39;INVOICE DATA:&#39;</span><span class="op">,</span> <span class="bu">JSON</span><span class="op">.</span><span class="fu">stringify</span>(inv)<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb11-11"><a href="#cb11-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">&#39;QUESTION: &#39;</span> <span class="op">+</span> question<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb11-12"><a href="#cb11-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  ]<span class="op">.</span><span class="fu">join</span>(<span class="st">&#39;</span><span class="sc">\n</span><span class="st">&#39;</span>)<span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb11-13"><a href="#cb11-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span>
<span id="cb11-14"><a href="#cb11-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb11-15"><a href="#cb11-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">export</span> <span class="kw">async</span> <span class="kw">function</span> <span class="fu">askGemini</span>(question<span class="op">:</span> <span class="dt">string</span><span class="op">,</span> inv<span class="op">:</span> DocumentItem) {</span>
<span id="cb11-16"><a href="#cb11-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  <span class="cf">try</span> {</span>
<span id="cb11-17"><a href="#cb11-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="kw">const</span> response <span class="op">=</span> <span class="cf">await</span> ai<span class="op">.</span><span class="at">models</span><span class="op">.</span><span class="fu">generateContent</span>({</span>
<span id="cb11-18"><a href="#cb11-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      model<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">&#39;gemini-2.5-flash&#39;</span><span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb11-19"><a href="#cb11-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      contents<span class="op">:</span> <span class="fu">buildInvoicePrompt</span>(question<span class="op">,</span> inv)<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb11-20"><a href="#cb11-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>      config<span class="op">:</span> { responseMimeType<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">&#39;application/json&#39;</span> }<span class="op">,</span></span>
<span id="cb11-21"><a href="#cb11-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    })<span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb11-22"><a href="#cb11-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> <span class="bu">JSON</span><span class="op">.</span><span class="fu">parse</span>(response<span class="op">.</span><span class="at">text</span> <span class="op">??</span> <span class="st">&#39;{}&#39;</span>)<span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb11-23"><a href="#cb11-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  } <span class="cf">catch</span> {</span>
<span id="cb11-24"><a href="#cb11-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> { answer<span class="op">:</span> <span class="st">&#39;The assistant is unavailable right now.&#39;</span><span class="op">,</span> citations<span class="op">:</span> [] }<span class="op">;</span></span>
<span id="cb11-25"><a href="#cb11-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>  }</span>
<span id="cb11-26"><a href="#cb11-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span></code></pre></div>
<ul>
<li><strong>Citations:</strong> each string (e.g.
<code>invoiceNumber</code>, <code>totalAmount</code>,
<code>poReference</code>) maps to a bounding box; clicking the badge
highlights that region.</li>
<li><strong>Going live:</strong> the prototype uses keyword matching for
replies. Swap it for <code>askGemini</code> — the UI needs no
changes.</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>The code in this README is simplified and representative — check it
against your source.</p>
</blockquote>

<div class="sourceCode" id="cb13"><pre class="sourceCode bash"><code class="sourceCode bash"><span id="cb13-1"><a href="#cb13-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">npm</span> run build      <span class="co"># optimized files → dist/</span></span>
<span id="cb13-2"><a href="#cb13-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="ex">npm</span> run preview    <span class="co"># check the build at http://localhost:4173</span></span></code></pre></div>
<p>Works on <strong>Netlify · Vercel · GitHub Pages · Cloudflare Pages ·
Firebase Hosting</strong>.</p>
<table>

<th>Value</th>

<p>If the host returns 404 on refresh, enable its single-page-app
fallback to <code>index.html</code>.</p>
<hr />
<h2 id="-security-notes">🛡 Security Notes</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>API key exposure</strong> — Vite embeds <code>define</code>
values in the browser bundle, so anyone can read the key in dev tools.
Fine for a local prototype; for production, call Gemini from a
<strong>server or serverless function</strong> that holds the key.</li>
<li><strong>Never commit secrets</strong> — keep <code>.env.local</code>
in <code>.gitignore</code>; rotate the key if it leaks.</li>
<li><strong>Sensitive documents</strong> — invoices contain pricing and
banking data; check data-handling terms before using a real model.</li>
<li><strong>Uploads</strong> — validate type and size on the server too;
scan for malware.</li>
<li><strong>Prompt injection</strong> — invoice text may contain
instructions aimed at the model; treat it as data and keep a human in
the loop.</li>
<li><strong>Access control</strong> — production needs authentication,
approval limits, and an audit trail.</li>
</ul>
<hr />
<h2 id="-troubleshooting">🩺 Troubleshooting</h2>
<details>
<summary><b>Common problems and fixes</b></summary>

<table>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Symptom</th>
<th>Fix</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>npm run dev</code> fails (&quot;command not found&quot;)</td>
<td>Run <code>npm install</code> in the project root</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Port 3000 already in use</td>
<td>Stop the other process or change <code>server.port</code> in
<code>vite.config.ts</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Blank page, console error about <code>process</code></td>
<td><code>GEMINI_API_KEY</code> undefined — check the
<code>define</code> block, restart the dev server</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>.env.local</code> changes ignored</td>
<td>Vite reads env files at start-up — restart
<code>npm run dev</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Styles missing</td>
<td>Check Tailwind directives in <code>index.css</code> and
<code>content</code> paths in <code>tailwind.config.js</code></td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Gemini 400 / 403</td>
<td>Invalid or restricted key, or API not enabled</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Gemini 429</td>
<td>Rate limit — retry with back-off</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Counts don&#39;t update after approving</td>
<td>State is being mutated — use immutable updates</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</details>
